text:
maya: Quick thread to finalize v1 networking: do we ship with full IP preservation or control-plane-only (BGP preserved, data-plane rotated)?

jordan: I favor control-plane-only for GA. Easier automation, fewer upgrade blockers.

sylvia: Field: customers ask for "no surprise" topology. Full IP-preserve is preferred by large accounts, but many will accept control-plane-only if documented.

alejandro: Engineering note: full IP-preserve needs agent to skip veth teardown + MAC pinning. Prototype ~1wk, harden ~2w. Also need integration tests for BGP adjacency stability.

devx: DX ask: add `redwoodctl network preflight` and a clear maintenance checklist. For preview customers, label feature "ip-stable-preview" and include SRE onboarding doc.

maya: Proposed plan: default=control-plane-only for GA; offer ip-stable-preview as opt-in for high-touch customers with SRE support. Launch gates: (1) installer flag + unit/tests (2) two field pilots (3) public docs + rollback runbook.

sylvia: Field can run pilots. We'll prepare sanitized checklists and escalation contacts.

alejandro: I'll scope a skip-teardown branch and a tiny relay fallback PoC (5d prototype). Note: relay requires customer bandwidth consent.

jordan: I'll own integration tests and the upgrade-playbook doc. Will include test matrix: small/medium/scale tenants and NIC bounce.

maya: Actions: @alejandro prototype, @jordan tests+playbook, @devx preflight + quickstart, @sylvia schedule pilots, ops-bot file ticket. Reconvene 48h.

ops-bot: Created PRIVNET-5001: "net-preserve rollout checklist" assigned to maya. Link: https://redwood.internal/PRIVNET-5001

maya: Thanks — locking to control-plane-only default and preview track for full IP preservation. :white_check_mark:
